_README: Narration pronunciations for this content set. word -> IPA phonemes. The engine ships none of these on purpose: which words a narrator gets wrong is a property of the subject matter, not of DemoForge. Keys starting with _ are notes, not words.
_PRECEDENCE: Writing [word](/ipa/) directly in a narration.md always beats this file.
_HOW_TO_ADD: Check before adding, don't guess: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python -c "from kokoro import KPipeline; p=KPipeline(lang_code='a', model=False); [print(ps) for _,ps,_ in p('your word')]". Only add it if what comes back is actually wrong.
_AUDITED: The kit's technical vocabulary was checked against Kokoro's own lexicon on 2026-10-06. It already says Python, NumPy, Octave, DemoForge, covariance, estimator, planar, volumetric, traceability, firmware, regression, vectorize, CSV, PDF and xlsx correctly. Only the two below were wrong. Keep this file small.
_CACHE: Unlike the Books project, editing this file DOES invalidate the audio cache: the lexicon is applied before the text is hashed, so changed words re-synthesize on the next build.
